web.title: Steve Hackett: More European shows announced for 2026
web.description: Steve Hackett and his band will also be playing in Europe in May and June. The schedule includes shows in France, Belgium, Denmark, Sweden ...
web.markdown:
Today, Steve Hackett announced further shows in Europe. This includes Paris, Brussels, Scandinavia, Germany and the Netherlands in May and June 2026.

Following the announcement of his new _**Best Of Genesis & Solo Gems Tour 2026**_ with concerts in Florida and the UK, further shows were announced today. Steve Hackett and his band will also be playing in Europe in May and June.

The schedule includes shows in France, Belgium, Denmark, Sweden, two shows in the Netherlands and six shows in Germany. The exact dates can be found on the **[tour dates page](https://www.genesis-news.com/article/steve-hackett-best-of-genesis-solo-gems-tour-2026/)**. A special river [Rhine cruise](https://www.genesis-news.com/steve-hackett-joins-river-rhine-cruise-in-2026/) is scheduled for July.

Steve will not focus on a specific Genesis album in 2026. He will put together the set a little more freely. As usual, he will be supported by **Nad Sylvan** (vocals), **Rob Townsend** (saxophone, percussion, keyboards) and **Jonas Reingold** (bass / double neck guitar). Following the departure of Roger King, **Lalle Larsson** will also play keyboards. German drummer [**Felix Lehrmann**](https://felixlehrmann.de/) will play drums.
